steps.text: Reach the target number by combining the number cards with operations (+, −, ×, ÷).
Tap a number card, then an operation such as “+”, to build toward the target.
When your result is at (or closest to) the target, tap “Submit”.
Estimate first: which cards and operations get you into the target's range fastest?

coach.mission: Combine cards and operations to hit the target.
whenStuck: Tap a number card, then an operation like “+”. Use “Undo” to fix moves.
Estimate which cards get you near the target fastest.
whenWrong: You're off the target — estimate first, then adjust with a smaller card or a different operation.
Try Undo and aim for the target's range before fine-tuning.
coach.done: You've reached the target with number cards. Keep playing, or move on.

steps.text: Estimate which cards get you near the target, then tap a number card and an operation like “+”.
Adjust with more cards and operations; tap “Undo” to fix a move.
When you're at (or closest to) the target, tap “Submit”.

onCorrect: Yes — you planned the route to the target.
onWrong: Off the target — estimate first, then adjust with a smaller card or a different operation. Use Undo.
Aim for the target's range with big cards, then fine-tune.
practice.done: You can hit a target by estimating and combining numbers with operations!
